title.en: Tale 20 — The Ascetic and the Mongoose

sentences.ar: ناسك عنده ولد زغير وابن عرس ربّاه.
sentences.en: An ascetic had a small child and a mongoose he had raised.

sentences.ar: كان يثق فيه زي ما بيثق بولد.
sentences.en: He trusted it as he would trust a child.
One day, he left the child sleeping and went out.

sentences.ar: لما رجع، لقى ابن عرس عند الباب وتمه دم.
sentences.en: When he came back, he found the mongoose at the door with blood on its mouth.
He struck it quickly and killed it.

sentences.ar: وبعدين فات، ولقى الولد نايم بالسلامة.
sentences.en: And then he went in, and found the child sleeping safely.
And beside him a big snake, killed.

sentences.ar: قعد الناسك يبكي وما نفع البكا.
sentences.en: The ascetic sat weeping and the weeping was no use.

sentences.ar: اللي بيحكم بسرعة بيندم على مهل.
